description: This file implements a kernel log monitor for the Cuttlefish project, handling log collection from a UNIX socket or file descriptor, subscribing external file descriptors for log events, and managing the main event loop for log processing.

classes.name: KernelLogServer
classes.description: A class responsible for managing kernel log collection, subscription, and event handling.

methods.name: SubscribersFromCmdline
methods.description: Parses the subscriber_fds command line argument, validates, and converts it into a vector of SharedFD objects.

methods.name: KernelLogMonitorMain
methods.description: Main function that initializes the log monitor, sets up signal handling, opens log pipe, subscribes to events, and runs the event loop.
